note: Fourteen applicant questions for SOP-LIC-014, written to measure the ReAct loop. Re-created from the description in docs/agent-lifecycle-journey.md (8 in the SOP, 6 not), because the original list was not committed; they are not the original 14. 'expect' is the set of chunk ids any one of which is an acceptable citation; 'outside' means the SOP cannot answer and the agent must make the outside-information call. Written by the person who built the agent, so read results as a smoke test, not a benchmark.
